responsibility: This implementation module is an empty compatibility stub for the Logitech DebugPMD module. It provides no runtime behavior, data structures, or helpers, and exists solely so legacy GNU Modula-2 programs can link against an otherwise absent debugging module name.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation stub for DebugPMD: unlike DebugPMD.def, it is the empty implementation body that satisfies the definition module at link/build time.
